title: The Grand 30A | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: The Grand 30A - Luxury 18-bedroom, 16-bathroom West 30A Estate — Sleeps 44, Perfect for Large Groups & Beach GetawaysFavorite...
description_expanded: The Grand 30A - Luxury 18-bedroom, 16-bathroom West 30A Estate — Sleeps 44, Perfect for Large Groups & Beach Getaways Favorite Features - Private Pool - Media and Game Room - Near Beach About The Grand 30A: Experience unmatched luxury on scenic 30A in this stunning 18-bedroom, 15 full-bath, 2 half-bath beachfront estate that sleeps up to 44 guests — the ultimate destination for large family vacations, reunions, corporate retreats, and special celebrations. Just steps from the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters, this expansive coastal home offers a wealth of resort-style amenities and thoughtful touches throughout. Step outside to your own private 24' × 60' heated pool and spa, where endless fun and relaxation await. The first-floor outdoor space features a poolside grill, perfect for barbecues and alfresco dining with family and friends. When you’re ready for more entertainment, head to the fully equipped game room with a pool table, arcade games, and plenty of space for friendly competition. Inside, you’ll find spacious, beautifully designed living areas with coastal elegance and comfort. Enjoy movie nights in the dedicated home theater, and effortlessly access every level with the in-home elevator. Multiple gathering spaces and expansive windows offer breathtaking views and an inviting atmosphere for group activities or quiet relaxation. With luxurious amenities, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location near premier dining, boutique shopping, and easy beach access, this extraordinary 30A estate redefines large-group coastal living. Unwind, entertain, and create lasting memories at this exceptional 30A beachfront retreat with poolside grilling, panoramic Gulf views, and luxury for every guest.
